name: Promo blocks
descr: The promo blocks of the shop: a tree of blocks, and under every one of them the texts it shows, the goods it gathers, the places it hangs in and the option rows set on it. The types - kind_key here, obj_key on a link - are values of ADVERT_KIND_KEY, ADVERT_TEXT_KIND_KEY, ADVERT_GOODS_KIND_KEY, ADVERT_LINK_KIND_KEY and ADVERT_LINK_OBJ_KEY in the base settings, and the Settings tool answers them. The pictures of a text belong to the Files tool, element advert_text.

commands.name: CmdList
commands.descr: Reads the promo blocks whole - the tree, the texts of every block, the goods it gathers, the places it hangs in and the option rows set: five tables in one answer.

commands.name: CmdAdd
commands.descr: Adds a promo block under a parent, or at the top of the tree when parent_id is 0. A folder only groups other blocks and shows nothing of its own.

params.name: parent_id
params.descr: id of the block it goes under; 0 puts it at the top of the tree

params.name: skey
params.descr: the character key of the block, the word a template calls it by

params.name: name
params.descr: the name of the block, as the people of the shop read it

params.name: kind_key
params.descr: a value of ADVERT_KIND_KEY

params.name: folder
params.descr: true - the block only groups others and shows nothing itself

commands.name: CmdUpdate
commands.descr: Changes the columns given of promo blocks, by id - what the call leaves out stays as it was.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the block, or several of them

params.name: skey
params.descr: the character key of the block

params.name: name
params.descr: the name of the block

params.name: kind_key
params.descr: a value of ADVERT_KIND_KEY

params.name: folder
params.descr: true - the block only groups others

commands.name: CmdMove
commands.descr: Moves a promo block under another parent, its whole branch with it.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the block to move

params.name: parent_id
params.descr: id of the block it goes under; 0 puts it at the top of the tree

commands.name: CmdRemove
commands.descr: Deletes promo blocks by id, with the branches under them. The first call counts what goes, depend does it.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the block, or several of them

params.name: depend
params.descr: true - the rows of the tables hanging on these go with them; without it such a deletion is refused

commands.name: CmdTextAdd
commands.descr: Adds a text to promo blocks: one row of advert_text on every block named.

params.name: advert_id
params.descr: id of the block, or several of them

params.name: name
params.descr: the name of the text

params.name: descr
params.descr: the text itself, as the storefront shows it

params.name: kind_key
params.descr: a value of ADVERT_TEXT_KIND_KEY

params.name: params
params.descr: the additional parameters of the text, as the program keeps them

params.name: date_time
params.descr: the day and hour the text carries; left out, it stays empty

params.name: pos
params.descr: the place of the row among the texts of that block; left out, a row takes its own id

commands.name: CmdTextUpdate
commands.descr: Changes the columns given of the texts, by id.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the text, or several of them

params.name: advert_id
params.descr: id of the block it moves to

params.name: name
params.descr: the name of the text

params.name: descr
params.descr: the text itself

params.name: kind_key
params.descr: a value of ADVERT_TEXT_KIND_KEY

params.name: params
params.descr: the additional parameters

params.name: date_time
params.descr: the day and hour the text carries

params.name: pos
params.descr: the place of the row among the texts of its block

commands.name: CmdTextRemove
commands.descr: Deletes texts by id. The pictures hanging on them go by depend.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the text, or several of them

params.name: depend
params.descr: true - the rows of the tables hanging on these go with them; without it such a deletion is refused

commands.name: CmdTextPos
commands.descr: Lays the texts of one block in order.

params.name: advert_id
params.descr: id of the block whose texts are put in order

params.name: type
params.descr: POS - the rows given go to the front in that order; MOVE - one row shifts by so many places, minus upwards; SORT - the whole list by a column

params.name: data
params.descr: the payload of that type: [{"id": 22}] for POS, [{"id": 22, "inc": -5}] for MOVE, {"field": "name", "direction": "ASC"} for SORT

commands.name: CmdGoodsAdd
commands.descr: Puts goods into promo blocks: one row of advert_goods on every block named. The goods itself is elem_id, and the Browser tool answers the ids.

params.name: advert_id
params.descr: id of the block, or several of them

params.name: elem_id

params.name: kind_key

params.name: params
params.descr: the additional parameters of the row

params.name: comment
params.descr: a comment of the staff, seen in the program alone

params.name: pos
params.descr: the place of the row among the goods of that block; left out, a row takes its own id

params.descr: id of the row, or several of them

params.name: advert_id
params.descr: id of the block it moves to

params.name: elem_id
params.descr: id of the goods the row stands for

params.name: kind_key
params.descr: a value of ADVERT_GOODS_KIND_KEY

params.name: params

params.name: comment

params.name: pos
params.descr: the place of the row among the goods of its block

commands.name: CmdGoodsRemove
commands.descr: Deletes the rows of advert_goods by id. The goods themselves stay as they are.

params.name: id

commands.name: CmdLinkAdd
commands.descr: Hangs promo blocks on an object of the shop: one row of advert_link on every block named. obj_key says what kind of object it is and param_id names it - a section, a goods, an attribute.

params.name: advert_id
params.descr: id of the block, or several of them

params.name: obj_key
params.descr: the kind of object the block hangs on: a value of ADVERT_LINK_OBJ_KEY

params.name: kind_key
params.descr: a value of ADVERT_LINK_KIND_KEY

params.name: param_id
params.descr: the number the object is named by - the id of a section, of a goods

params.name: params
params.descr: the additional parameters of the link

params.name: comment
params.descr: a comment of the staff, seen in the program alone

params.name: pos
params.descr: the place of the row among the links of that block; left out, a row takes its own id

commands.name: CmdLinkUpdate
commands.descr: Changes the columns given of the links, by id.

params.name: id

params.name: advert_id

params.name: obj_key
params.descr: the kind of object the block hangs on

params.name: kind_key
params.descr: a value of ADVERT_LINK_KIND_KEY

params.name: param_id
params.descr: the number the object is named by

params.name: params
params.descr: the additional parameters

params.name: comment

commands.name: CmdKeyAdd
commands.descr: Sets an option on promo blocks: one row of advert_key_set on every block named. The options are declared in the registry of the additional options, place advert.

params.name: advert_id
params.descr: id of the block, or several of them

params.name: key_id
params.descr: id of the option the row stands on

params.name: value_id
params.descr: id of the value of that option, when it keeps a list of them

params.name: value_txt
params.descr: the value written by hand, when the option keeps no list

commands.name: CmdKeyUpdate
commands.descr: Changes the columns given of the rows of advert_key_set, by id.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the row, or several of them

params.name: key_id
params.descr: id of the option the row stands on

params.name: value_id
params.descr: id of the value of that option

params.name: value_txt
params.descr: the value written by hand

commands.descr: Deletes the rows of advert_key_set by id. The option itself stays in its tree.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the row, or several of them
